name: spec-commit
description: Commits all changes with the spec's own commit message, and passes when there is nothing to commit.

config.command: if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo 'tree clean: nothing to commit'; exit 0; fi; if [ -z "$CANOPY_SPEC_COMMIT_MESSAGE" ]; then echo 'CANOPY_SPEC_COMMIT_MESSAGE is empty'; exit 1; fi; git add -A && git commit -q -m "$CANOPY_SPEC_COMMIT_MESSAGE" && echo "committed $(git log -1 --oneline)"
